name: Upcoming Episodes & Movies
author: ChuckBuilds
description: What's coming out next: upcoming TV episodes from Sonarr or Jellyfin and movie releases from Radarr, with show logo or poster, S3E4, episode name, air date, runtime and a short description

versions.changelog: Initial release: upcoming episodes (Sonarr calendar, or Jellyfin's Upcoming list when Sonarr is not set up, with library selection) and upcoming movie releases (Radarr calendar: in theaters, digital, physical). Switch, scroll and Vegas modes; show logo or poster art; S3E4 / S03E04 / Season 3 Episode 4; toggleable episode name, short description, date and runtime; fonts and colors per element; layouts that scale from 64x32 to large panels.
